g.text: One tool call, step by step: Copilot → AI Gateway → OBO → MCP server
solid = request · dashed = response · green pills = tokens (every token carries the signed-in user's identity)
asks something that needs a tool
client_id = App A · scope = Data.All offline_access
T1 · aud = AI Gateway (18550318-…) · scp = Data.All · azp = App A
Azure RBAC: AI Gateway Tools User?
AI Gateway app is pre-authorized on App B
T1′ · aud = App B · still the user
MI assertion · sub = MI principal ID
OBO as App B · client_assertion = MI assertion
federated credential matches issuer · subject · audience?
admin consent App B → App C present?
T2 · aud = App C · scp = user_impersonation · azp = App B · oid = user
v2 issuer · aud = App C · client app = App B
aud, scp, azp allow-list → run the tool
tool result, e.g. whoami → your oid and name
A · Sign-in and renewal (offline_access requests refresh tokens)
B · MCP call through the gateway
C · On-Behalf-Of exchange, with no secrets anywhere
Steps 4–19 were verified end to end with scripts/test-obo.py, using an Azure CLI token with the same audience and scope as T1.
Step 6 runs inside the gateway; it's implied by the required pre-authorization of the AI Gateway app on App B.
